Guideline Name 
Zunveyl (benzgalantamine)  
Formulary

Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Zunveyl  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of mild to moderate dementia of the Alzheimer’s type  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 18 years of age or older

AND 
 
3 - Trial and failure (of a minimum 30-day supply), contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of 
the following:  
generic galantamine  
generic rivastigmine  
generic donepezil
